slides.headline: WHICH VISA DO YOU ACTUALLY NEED?
slides.sub: More people get this wrong than you would expect.
slides.note: Tourist or business. Schengen or national. Visa or electronic authorisation. The wrong answer means starting over.

slides.headline: WHAT CHANGES THE ANSWER
items: Your UAE residence status and its validity
Your purpose — tourism, business, study, family
Your route and where you will spend the most nights
Whether your destination uses a visa or a digital authorisation

slides.headline: A DISTINCTION THAT CATCHES PEOPLE
slides.never: Assume a business visa lets you work. It covers meetings, conferences, negotiations and site visits — representing your employer abroad. It does not cover being employed locally or being paid locally.
slides.instead: Describe the trip accurately and apply in the right category. Inventing a purpose is exactly the inconsistency officers are trained to find.
